name: @lulu/inspector
description: Lulu's UI -- chat plus a live Context Assembly panel (which memory shards were contacted, why, the judge's verdict per round, and the counterfactual cost of query_all/flat_topk). Talks to lulu-server over HTTP + SSE. Runs standalone in a browser for dev, or wrapped in the Tauri desktop shell (src-tauri/) for the installed app -- see ROADMAP.md's Tauri desktop shell entry.
